objective: Take Brann Bronzebeard's Letter to Bronzebeard's Encampment in southern Silithus.
start: Dropped by many mobs in Silithus

description: If you're reading this, I'm either dead or soon to be dead. It's hard to say. Most of the crew is dead anyhow.
Found information about a Titan. Great battle between him and an Old God. Yes, a bona fide Old God. Found ancient tunnel leading to Ahn'Qiraj. Taking it.
Take this letter to my old camp. Make sure my monkey is getting adequate food, water, and hugs.
P.S. Watch out for crazy Old God worshipping night elf.
completion: Well this explains a lot. If you ever find a way into Ahn'Qiraj, keep an eye out for ol' Brann. I'm afraid that he'll be powerless without his monkey.
